cohort: Women with a singleton pregnancy who maintained a consistent diet (vegan, lacto-ovo-vegetarian, fish-eater, or omnivore) prior to and throughout pregnancy were enrolled.
finding: A maternal vegan diet was significantly associated with an increased risk for small-for-gestational-age newborns and lower birthweight compared to other diet types.
birth_weight: Mean birthweights observed were 3015g for vegans, 3285g for lacto-ovo-vegetarians, and 3328g for omnivores.
